title: Nine Minutes of Doing
subtitle: 家务与杂活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家务与杂活（生活与学习·家庭劳动）
meta: 主题语境：家务与杂活（生活与学习·家庭劳动）　|　核心词汇：chore　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 chore 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 my mother was sent to do ① chore she could not finish, and she said the doing was the whole of the lesson. The ② chore, meaning the task and not the day, was nine minutes long and was done by whoever came last; chore, she said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ chore in that house had the same sound, and the ④ chore at the end, meaning the one the mother kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever did properly. Chore, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ chore was the whole of the morning, meaning the duty it carried and not the task. The ⑥ chore, meaning the duty and not any of that, is the only thing in a morning that everybody shares and nobody questions; chore, he said, is either something you do or the only word that means both a task and a duty. She said the duty is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ chore had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the sound. The ⑧ chore of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine minutes and eleven years of doing; chore, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ chore I remember is the one at the end, which was done in 1969 and is still described as the smallest in the county. A ⑩ chore, my grandmother said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being done; every chore, she said, is a duty that has agreed to look like a task. She said the duty was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 杂活（指那件活本身，与那一整天相对）
C. 固定搭配：do a chore 做一件家务
D. n. 杂活（指那栋房子里每一件）
E. n. 杂活（指末尾那一件）
F. n. 本分（抽象：它承载的那份责任）
G. n. 那份责任（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The chore, meaning the task and not the day
chore was the whole of the morning
the chore had become a number in a report
The chore of the whole thing
A chore, my grandmother said in 1974

answers.why: do a chore 意为“做一件家务”，1949 年母亲被派去做她做不完的那件家务。
chore 意为“家务活、杂活”，指那件活本身而不是那一整天，长九分钟，由最后来的人做。
chore 指那栋房子里每一件杂活，每一件都是同样的声音。
chore 指末尾那一件（母亲留下的那一件），是唯一有人认真做过的。
chore 意为“本分”，抽象指它承载的那份责任，父亲说 chore 就是那个早晨的全部。
chore 为抽象用法，指那份责任本身，是一个早晨里人人都分担、却没人质疑的东西。
chore 意为“家务活、杂活”，到 1964 年这件 chore 成了报告里的一个数字。
chore 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九分钟和十一年的劳作。
chore 意为“杂活”，我记得的是末尾那一件，1969 年做过，至今仍被说成全县最小的。
chore 为抽象总称，祖母说一件家务是唯一会因为被认真做完而变好的东西。
